artworks.title: William Gunn
artworks.artist: Richard James Lane after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man's upper body in profile view. The man has a prominent brow, long nose, firm lips, and short thinning hair. He is dressed in a high-collared garment, with sketch-like lines showing folds. There are no visible objects or jewelry in his hands. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Thomas Chevalier
artworks.description: This image shows a man from the waist up, in profile view, with facial features revealing a prominent nose and deep-set eyes, and wearing a high-collared garment with a scarf or cravat wrapped around his neck. The background is plain with a textured pattern, and the bottom of the image contains text identifying the man as Thomas Chevalier, Surgeon Extraordinary to the King and Professor of Anatomy and Surgery for the Royal College of Surgeons in London.

artworks.title: Children with Donkey and Dog in a Clearing
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered outdoors. Some are sitting on the ground, while others are standing or leaning against trees. Three central figures are seated; two are leaning on each other while the third is hooded and faces away. The standing individuals vary in posture; one kneels with a hand to the face, while another, wearing a hat with a feather, stands nearby. Their facial features suggest a mix of contemplative and relaxed expressions. All the figures are dressed in long robes or simple clothing fitting the pastoral setting, and there are no visible pieces of jewelry. A couple of dogs stand near the group, and three orbs rest on the ground. The background is filled with dense foliage of trees, creating an intimate and shaded atmosphere in a natural setting.

artworks.title: Lady Charlotte Susan Maria Bury
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman in profile view. She has finely detailed facial features and serene gaze. Her styled hair is braided or coiled elegantly. She wears a formal garment with a fur-like collar. The background is monochromatic with subtle shading, hinting at a column behind her to the right. No jewelry or objects are visible in the portrait.

artworks.title: Elizabeth Montague
artworks.artist: William Ridley after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a side profile portrait. She is seated and facing right, with her head slightly tilted downwards. She has delicate and well-defined facial features with a soft expression. Her hair is styled elegantly, gathered at the top with decorative detailing, possibly a cap or net with lace trim. She is wearing a garment with ruffled detailing along the neckline and sleeves, indicative of 18th-century fashion, and a small round earring is visible. The background features an oval frame with a patterned interior, with a classic sepia tone. The portrait is set on a plain background with text below the image reading "Mrs. Montagu."

artworks.title: Henry Fuseli
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's head and shoulders in an oval frame. The man is depicted in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. He has distinct facial features, a strong jawline, prominent cheekbones, and a focused expression. His hair is light-colored, wavy, and styled away from his face. He is dressed in a high-collared garment typical of early 19th-century fashion, consisting of a dark coat and a light scarf or cravat around his neck. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the image. The background features a textured pattern, typical of engraved portraits, with a plain, light-colored finish on the outer area, showing signs of age. The text below the image identifies him as "HENRY FUSELI Esq R.A," along with the publishers and the publication date of January 31, 1801.

artworks.title: Prince Hoare Esq.
artworks.description: The image is an upper-body portrait of Prince Hoare Esq., shown from the chest up. The person is positioned slightly turned to the side, gazing towards the viewer with a composed expression. He has a youthful face with an aquiline nose, a gentle jawline, and curly, short hair that is neatly styled away from the face. He is dressed in 18th-century attire, wearing a coat with an elaborate collar and a white cravat adorning his neck. The background is a textured gradient with the suggestion of draped fabric in the upper corner. The engraving is bordered and labeled below with the name "Prince Hoare Esq." and publication details.

artworks.title: Thomas Holcroft
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the waist up. The man is positioned with his body slightly turned to the side, but his head is facing forward, gazing directly at the viewer. He has a composed expression on his face. His facial features include a prominent nose and small, focused eyes. His hairstyle is short and neatly combed, with hair swept back from his forehead. He wears a dark, formal coat with large lapels, and under the coat, he has a white shirt with a high collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the man. The background consists of a textured, dark pattern that adds depth and contrast to highlight the figure within the central oval frame of the portrait. The portrait includes the text "Thomas Holcroft, Esq." underneath.

artworks.title: William Hayley, Esq.
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man with his upper body, positioned seated with his head resting on his right hand, supported by a stack of books or a similar object. The man has high cheekbones, a broad forehead, well-defined eyebrows, wavy hair combed back, and is dressed in 18th-century attire of a jacket, waistcoat, and cravat. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being actively held. The background is a plain, lightly tinted surface with a dark oval framing the man's portrait.

artworks.title: Sir David Wilkie, R.A.
artworks.artist: John Henry Robinson after Sir William Beechey
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the waist up. He is seated, slightly turned and leaning forward with his head facing the viewer. The man has an oval-shaped face with prominent cheekbones and a neutral expression. His eyes are looking to the side. He has short, curly hair and is dressed in formal attire, including a dark suit jacket, high-collared shirt, and cravat. He is holding a palette and brushes in one hand. The background is dark, with a faint outline of a group scene visible. The engraving includes text identifying the man as "Sir David Wilkie, R.A." and his signature.

artworks.title: La Belle Hamilton
artworks.artist: Charles Rolls after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with a slight turn to her right. She has curly hair, a jeweled headpiece, and is dressed in a flowing gown. She holds a feather quill in her right hand. The background includes a column to her left and heavy curtains to her right.

artworks.title: Albrecht V. Haller
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a bust-length portrait of a man named Albrecht von Haller. The portrait shows him facing slightly to the right, with curly hair extending to his shoulders. He has a broad forehead, downturned mouth, and a defined nose. He is depicted wearing an ornate coat with several buttons and a cravat around his neck. The engraving is housed within a circular frame adorned with intricate patterns and swags. The background features detailed line work, and the frame is surrounded by additional decorative elements. Below the illustration, the name "ALBRECHT V. HALLER" is engraved in capital letters.

artworks.title: Henry Blundell
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a man in profile from the chest up. The man is facing left with distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and a thoughtful expression. He has short, neatly combed hair and wears elegant attire from the 18th or early 19th century. The image is set against a plain background with speckled details, and there is an inscription identifying the man as Henry Blundell Esq. of Ince Blundell, along with additional text in Roman numerals and English.

artworks.title: Rev. John Clowes
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man from the waist up. He is in a side profile in a chair, with one arm on the armrest and the other hand holding an open book on his lap. The man appears older, with deep-set eyes and a serious expression. His hair is white and styled to the sides and back. He wears formal attire, including a dark coat and a white shirt. A stack of books is on the table next to him. In the background, there is a plain wall with a curtain and some architectural details.

artworks.title: A Jewish Rabbi
artworks.artist: William P. Sherlock after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing from the waist up with hands folded in front of him. He has a beard, mustache and wears a turban, robe with embroidery, and holds a cloth. Background includes furniture and a lamp on a table, indicating a dimly lit interior with arches and depth.

artworks.title: Josiah Wedgwood
artworks.artist: George Salisbury Shury after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. He is facing slightly to the right, seated, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a prominent forehead, large eyes, and a slightly curved mouth. His hair is styled in curls, similar to an 18th-century wig. He wears a dark coat over a white shirt with a high collar. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, and the portrait is on light-colored textured paper. Below the image, it reads 'Josiah Wedgwood, F.R.S.' with details about the portrait's origin.

artworks.title: Monument to William Shakespeare
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a central figure flanked by two allegorical figures. The drawing depicts a central seated figure on a rock with a contemplative expression. To the left, an allegorical figure holding a mask and a lyre is shown, and to the right, another allegorical figure holds a palette. The use of line work is meticulous, providing texture and depth, particularly in the drapery of the clothing and the detailing of the rock. The overall composition suggests a meeting of different artistic disciplines, unified through the central figure's prominence and the interactive gestures of the side figures. The use of fine lines and crosshatching is evident throughout the drawing, adding to the classical appearance of the artwork.

artworks.title: Abraham Rees, D.D.
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a gentleman seated formally. He has a round face, refined features, and wears a powdered wig. He is dressed in a dark coat with buttons, a light-colored waistcoat, and a white shirt. His right hand rests on folded papers, and a quill and inkpot are on a table beside him. In the background, there is a draped curtain. Surrounding the image is text with the subject's name, "Abraham Rees D.D.," titles, and credentials.

artworks.title: Antonio Canova
artworks.artist: James Thomson possibly after John Jackson
artworks.description: The image is a bust-length portrait of a man, depicted from the chest up. He is facing slightly to his right with his head turned towards the viewer, showing his face. The man has a prominent nose, slightly furrowed brows, and a reserved expression. His hair is dark, softly curled, and styled away from his face. He is wearing a dark cloak with a high collar, and an undergarment with a lighter color around the neck. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the subject. The background is plain with minimal detailing, emphasizing the artistic dotwork used to create the portrait.

artworks.title: Bust of Sir Walter Scott
artworks.artist: James Thomson after Sir Francis Legatt Chantrey
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a bust from the chest up. The person is facing slightly to the right with their head turned further to the right. The facial features are detailed, showing a strong profile with a broad forehead, deep-set eyes, and a prominent chin. The hair is short and wavy, framing the head closely. The subject is draped in a patterned fabric, resembling a toga. There are no visible items in the plain background, directing focus to the bust. Text below indicates it is an engraving of "The Author of Waverley" by Thompson from a bust by Chantrey, with the name Walter Scott scripted below, along with publication details.

artworks.title: John Brown, M.D.
artworks.description: The image presents a man in a half-length portrait. He is seated and facing the viewer, with a gentle smile. The man has distinct features, light-colored neatly combed hair, and no facial hair. He is dressed in a dark coat with large buttons, a waistcoat, and a white cravat. The background is plain and dark. The name "John Brown M. D." is written below the portrait, along with engraver's and publisher's information.

artworks.title: John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man seated in a frontal position. The man has a bald head with light, loose hair flowing down from the sides. His facial features include a prominent forehead, a high nose, and slightly pursed lips. The man is dressed in an elegant coat with broad lapels over a buttoned waistcoat and white shirt. The high collar of the shirt can be seen peeking out from the top. There appear to be no jewelry or objects present. The background is plain, and the illustration is identified by the signature below as "John Flaxman".

artworks.title: Edinburgh, from Craigleith
artworks.artist: William Tombleson after Thomas Hosmer Shepherd
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a scene overlooking the city of Edinburgh from Craigleith. The viewpoint is from a lower perspective, close to trees and stones on the left. Edinburgh Castle is visible on a rocky hill, surrounded by hills and buildings. The engraving is detailed with fine lines for texture. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of brown. In the foreground, two figures are walking with sheep and a dog, leading to a cityscape with vegetation, buildings, and hills under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Rev. Reginald Heber, D.D.
artworks.description: The image shows a man posing for an upper body portrait. He is facing slightly right but looking directly at the viewer with a calm expression. The man has short, curly hair and detailed facial features. He is dressed in clerical attire, including a long robe with puffed sleeves, a white ruffled shirt, and a dark stole draped over his shoulders. The background is plain, emphasizing the man's attire and features. The portrait is framed with a blank space containing text identifying the subject and creators.
